digest.title: RTX Spark Ignites Global Celebration as New Windows PCs Arrive
digest.tldr: NVIDIA RTX Spark laptops are now available, bringing NVIDIA Blackwell RTX graphics, up to 128GB of unified memory and the full NVIDIA AI platform to slim, premium Windows PCs.

digest.title: Meta removes language that may have allowed it to scrape news sites
digest.tldr: After backlash, Meta is updating its terms again to remove language that suggested it could scrape content from sites, including news sites, to train its AI.
